mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates and increases liquidity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS 3-month change falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 0.3pp rise), or Rank IC for UNRATE 1-month change falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint decline signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC for RSAFS 3-month change falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase and non-farm payrolls decline signal labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Ultra-low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) support risk-taking and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as accommodative policy boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.5% falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
